description: Consolidated opt-out classifier rules. Rule entries are deduplicated globally by exact pattern text plus flags.
notes: The active Python pipeline applies classifier.py rules first, then optout_classifier/deterministic_rules.py.
deterministic_rules.js overlaps with optout_classifier/deterministic_rules.py; duplicate exact pattern strings are omitted.
The Zapier workflow code-step rules are included under rules.zapier_code_step because some regex sources differ from the Python port.
Rules are placed in their first encountered group; later duplicate pattern+flags pairs are omitted.

specific_request_rules.name: order_status
specific_request_rules.pattern: \b(?:where(?: is|'s)? my order|order status|track(?:ing)?(?: my)? order)\b

hard_rules.name: wrong_number
hard_rules.pattern: \bwrong (?:number|person)\b|\b(?:this is not|not) my number\b|\byou have the wrong number\b

hard_rules.name: number_no_longer_in_service
hard_rules.pattern: \bthis phone(?: number)? is no longer in service\b

non_opt_out_rules.name: notification_status_or_focus_mode
non_opt_out_rules.pattern: ^i m not receiving notifications if this is urgent reply urgent to send a notification through with your original message(?: i m driving with focus turned on i ll see your message when i get where i m going)?$

non_opt_out_rules.name: subscribe_confirmation_prompt
non_opt_out_rules.pattern: ^send this text to subscribe to recurring automated personalized marketing alerts e g cart reminders from darc sport ref f jgm$
